MVF4_univalence.blocker: univalence axiom is not in Lean 4 core; requires either mathlib4 (which carries quotient/propext but not full UA) or hand-authored axiom + matching higher-inductive-types or a HoTT library port

loc_estimate.if_classical_propext_only: ~15 LOC (extends Eq to Prop iff via propext, but only handles Prop universe — NOT full HoTT univalence)
loc_estimate.if_full_HoTT_univalence_axiom_postulated: ~25 LOC declaration + ~50 LOC application demos, but no longer axiom-free (will print `axioms: univalence`)
loc_estimate.if_proper_HoTT_lib_port: ~500-2000 LOC and weeks of work; needs cubical or HoTT-specific kernel features Lean 4 lacks

dep_chain_estimate.mathlib4_first_build: ~1-2 hr from scratch, ~5 min with `lake exe cache get`

MVF4_univalence.recommended_next_step: MVF4a: postulate `axiom univalence : ...` + prove a single application (e.g., transport along an equivalence) WITHOUT mathlib4, accepting one named axiom. This isolates the axiom cost honestly and unblocks downstream rungs without a 1+ GB dep.
